beats.text: Healthcare in the United States costs 13,473 per person. Sudan spends 28.
One big country breaks this pattern. It is not the one you would guess.
Is it Switzerland at 10,602, Germany at 8,826, or China?
The United States is the world's highest, at 13,473.
Sudan is the lowest at 28. It counts current expenditures on health per person.
